Short on time this week? Here’s the AI news worth knowing.

Anthropic filed to list its stock publicly on Nasdaq. Revenue for the first half of 2026: $16.3B, up from $1.2B a year earlier. Compute spending fell from about 6.5x revenue to about 0.5x.

AA Intelligence Index v5: 60% of the score now comes from private or held out tests. Opus 5.5 (max) 58, GPT-6 Astra 57, GPT-6.1 Sol 55. Sol costs about an eighth as much per task.

Effort matters: Opus 5.5 scores 35 at low effort and 58 at max, but at 10x the cost.

Unlimited OCR 2: 3.34B params, MIT license, hundreds of pages per request.
